subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Recognises consonant digraphs sh, ch, th, wh at the beginning and end of words (sh-irt, wh-en, wi-sh, bo-th)

show.line: Two letters, one sound. sh as in shirt. ch as in chair. th as in thumb. wh as in wheel!

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with sh, as in shirt?
Listen to the end of the word. Fish. Which sound is at the end?
Say the word that starts with wh. It is round and it rolls.
Which one ends with th, as in bath?
sh, ch or th? Put each picture with its starting sound.
Which word has wh at the start? Tap the picture.

hints: Listen to the very first sound. Is it sh, ch, th or wh?
sh is quiet like a librarian. ch is like a sneeze. th pokes your tongue out.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with ch.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Shoe starts with sh. Chair starts with ch.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. ch, ch, chair. Chair starts with ch!

parent_line: Can hear sh, ch, th and wh at the start and end of words.
